params.script_inline:
import sys, json
doc = json.load(sys.stdin)
d = doc["body"]
envelope = doc["envelope"]
h = envelope.get("header") or {}
hop = h.get("hop") or {}
ctx = h.get("context") or {}
route = str(hop.get("route") or "")
finish = str(hop.get("finish_reason") or "")
reason = str(hop.get("reject_reason") or "")
# The check's own codes (GH #1079), and since GH #1225 the ones of the source
# an item names itself: none, one the check does not know, or a store that
# failed while the source's rows were read -- never the keeper's `store_refused`.
VERIFY_REASONS = ("quote_missing", "quote_not_in_source", "source_missing",
                  "source_unknown", "store_error")
if route == "reject" and reason in VERIFY_REASONS:
    # A quote of a sidecar section that did not stand where the composite's
    # knob `sidecar_verify` says it must (GH #1079): `./curator` refuses the
    # item and says which section, which field and why -- never the item's
    # words, because a drain is no place to file what the model claimed the
    # person said, and a class is all a count needs. Told apart by the check's
    # own codes: the keeper's refusal below carries a `reject_reason` too
    # (`store_refused`, gh343) and is untouched.
    session = str(hop.get("session_id") or ctx.get("session_id") or "")
    turn = str(hop.get("turn_id") or ctx.get("turn_id") or "")
    section = str(hop.get("section") or "")
    field = str(hop.get("field") or "")
    text = ("talky reject: source=sidecar_verify reason=%s section=%s field=%s session=%s turn=%s"
            % (reason, section, field, session, turn))
    sys.stdout.write(json.dumps([{
        "header": {"route": "error", "error_code": reason, "error_source": "sidecar_verify",
                   "session_id": session, "turn_id": turn, "reject_reason": reason,
                   "section": section, "field": field,
                   "episode_turn_id": str(hop.get("episode_turn_id")
                                          or ctx.get("episode_turn_id") or "")},
        "messages": [{"origin": "assistant", "type": "text", "text": text}]}]))
    sys.exit(0)
if route == "reject":
    # The session-keeper's store refusal (GH #343). It is not a failed
    # inference, so it carries no finish_reason -- and its code sits in
    # hop.store_error, because the cell that reports it did not itself fail:
    # the store it spoke to did.
    source = "session-keeper"
elif finish:
    # The model cell that failed (GH #1536): talky's edge into this drain
    # stamps its name as `hop.failed_cell` -- a cell knows no topology, so
    # the name can only come from the edge. A parent edge that predates the
    # stamp still reads as the brain, the one model cell it used to name.
    source = str(hop.get("failed_cell") or "brain")
else:
    source = "unknown"
code = str(hop.get("error_code") or hop.get("store_error") or finish or "error")
session = str(hop.get("session_id") or ctx.get("session_id") or "")
turn = str(hop.get("turn_id") or ctx.get("turn_id") or "")
text = "talky error: source=%s code=%s session=%s turn=%s" % (source, code, session, turn)
out = [{
    "header": {"route": "error", "error_code": code, "error_source": source,
               "session_id": session, "turn_id": turn},
    "messages": [{"origin": "assistant", "type": "text", "text": text}]}]
# GH #1619: a failed model call of a person's turn left the person in silence
# -- the report above goes up to the colony's drain and nothing to the channel
# (run b18-6: 12 provider errors and one timeout, each a turn without an
# answer; the owner's "never silence"). The knob `error_reply` names ONE
# sentence the person hears instead, on route `answer` beside the report,
# which stays as it is. Empty (shipped) is today's bytes. Only for the three
# model cells, and never where somebody else answers the turn or nobody waits:
# a delegated errand (the duplex cell hears the failure itself, GH #1536), a
# side or sections call and a tool interim (the turn's answer still comes from
# the brain), an inner turn (no person spoke), a duplex advice round (the
# voice on the wire speaks), a self summary, a partial's stamp.
P = doc.get("params") or {}
reply = P.get("error_reply")
reply = reply if isinstance(reply, str) and reply.strip() else ""
quiet = (str(ctx.get("delegation_id") or "") != ""
         or str(ctx.get("call_kind") or "") in ("side", "sections")
         or str(ctx.get("interim") or "") != ""
         or str(ctx.get("inner_source") or "") != ""
         or str(ctx.get("channel") or "").startswith("inner:")
         or str(ctx.get("engine") or "") == "duplex"
         or str(ctx.get("summarize") or "") == "1"
         or str(ctx.get("delta") or "") == "1")
if reply and finish and source in ("brain", "quick", "quick_bridge") and not quiet:
    out.append({
        "header": {"route": "answer", "error_reply": "1", "error_code": code,
                   "error_source": source, "session_id": session, "turn_id": turn},
        "messages": [{"origin": "assistant", "type": "text", "text": reply}]})
sys.stdout.write(json.dumps(out))

error_reply.description: GH #1619: the ONE sentence a person hears when a model call of their turn fails (`brain`, `quick` or `quick_bridge`, error or content filter): emitted on route `answer` beside the unchanged report, never for a delegated errand, a side or sections call, a tool interim, an inner turn, a duplex advice round or a self summary. Empty (shipped) = the report alone, today's bytes. A set names its own words with `override_params` on `talky/errors`.

reject_reason.description: GH #1079: on a refused quote, why -- `quote_missing` or `quote_not_in_source`, and since GH #1225, for an item checked at the source it names, `source_missing`, `source_unknown` or `store_error`; also the `error_code`

section.description: GH #1079: on a refused quote, the sidecar section it was in

field.description: GH #1079: on a refused quote, the first field of the item that failed

episode_turn_id.description: GH #1079: on a refused quote, the person's episode of the turn the section annotated

error_reply.description: GH #1619: `1` on the answer the knob `error_reply` says for a failed model call; absent on every report

description.purpose: The composite's ONE error drain port: three failure lanes from two cells -- the brain's error and its content filter, the session-keeper's store refusal -- fan in here and leave as one normalised report on route error, so a parent tree drains a single edge instead of three lanes. Since talky@4.3.0 (GH #447) the summarizer's failed summary is not one of them any more: the composite carries no summarizer. Since GH #1079 a fourth lane fans in: `./curator`'s refusal of a quoted field that did not stand in its source (the splitter's knob `sidecar_verify`), source `sidecar_verify`.
description.use_when: Inside the talky composite. The parent MUST wire the exit somewhere - a log sink, an alarm, an operator surface; an unwired error lane dead-letters, which is loud but not actionable.
description.not_in_scope: No retry, no judgement, no swallowing, no words of its own (the one sentence of `error_reply` is the knob's, GH #1619): what a failure means is the parent's decision. Deliberately NOT a drain cell - a drain that ends inside the unit would make the failure invisible to the tree that owns the agent.
description.emits_meaning: route error: one report per failure, naming source (brain or session-keeper), error code, session and turn. For a keeper refusal the code is the STORE's error_code, read off hop.store_error -- the keeper itself did not fail, the store it spoke to did (GH #343). The report carries NO conversation content on purpose - the llm error lane echoes the PROMPT back, and a drain is not the place to file it. For a refused quote (GH #1079) the source is `sidecar_verify`, the code the `reject_reason` (`quote_missing`, `quote_not_in_source`, and since GH #1225 `source_missing`, `source_unknown`, `store_error`), and the report names section, field and the person's episode beside session and turn -- never the item's words. And since GH #1619, when the knob `error_reply` is set, route answer: ONE answer for the person whose turn a model cell (brain, quick or quick_bridge) failed, its text the knob's sentence, `hop.error_reply` `1`, with error_code, error_source, session and turn as on the report beside it -- the report itself is unchanged and still leaves on error; a delegated errand, a side or sections call, a tool interim, an inner turn, a duplex advice round and a self summary get the report alone.
description.consumes_meaning: the brain's error / content_filter emission (finish_reason on the hop) and the session-keeper's reject emission (route on the hop, hop.store_error / hop.store_operation beside it). Anything else is reported as source unknown rather than swallowed. And `./curator`'s reject emission with `hop.reject_reason` beside `section`, `field`, `session_id`, `turn_id`, `episode_turn_id` (GH #1079); any other reject is the keeper's, `reject_reason` `store_refused` included.
examples: provider 500 at the brain -> one report, source brain, code error
the session store refuses the nightly sweep -> one report, source session-keeper, code query_timeout
a quote of a sidecar section the person never said -> one report, source sidecar_verify, code quote_not_in_source, no words
provider 500 at the brain with error_reply set -> the report, and one answer with that sentence for the person
